governance.current_rule_file: 足球项目_CURRENT_唯一正式规则_V5.2.0_PIT数据优先与尾部闭合统一晋级版.docx

estimand.primary_estimand: paired mean multiclass H/D/A LogLoss difference, challenger minus frozen baseline, on chronological OOS test fixtures
estimand.draw_specific_required_estimand: paired mean binary Draw-vs-Not-Draw LogLoss difference, challenger minus frozen baseline
estimand.claim_scope: predictive increment of the preregistered PIT information family only; no formal promotion authority

information_family.name: R45B_AUTHENTIC_PIT_ROLE_AVAILABILITY_PROCESS_TASK_MATCHUP
allowed_inputs: same-freeze source-backed expected/confirmed XI standard role slots
same-freeze unavailable/doubtful identities and source-backed replacement candidates
strict-prior SHOTS_SOT_PROXY process features; never relabeled as xG
deterministic fixed role-zone matchup interaction representation
same-freeze complete 1X2 market prices used only as the frozen baseline
forbidden_inputs: target or future match results before their chronological update point
retrospective-only lineup or injury states without admissible pre-kickoff availability time
manual role inference from formation order
closing odds substituted retrospectively when no same-freeze baseline snapshot exists

baseline.input_requirement: complete home/draw/away decimal prices observed at the same admissible freeze as the R45B fixture feature bundle
baseline.formula: r_i=1/odds_i for i in H,D,A; p_i=r_i/(r_H+r_D+r_A)

candidate_catalog.architecture: binary Draw-mass logistic offset on top of the frozen 1X2 baseline; home/away residual mass keeps the baseline H:A ratio

feature_vector.xi_zone_count_differences: home minus away counts for every fixed normalized role zone except goalkeeper
feature_vector.unavailable_zone_count_differences: home minus away unavailable/doubtful counts by the same non-goalkeeper zones
feature_vector.replacement_zone_count_differences: home minus away replacement-candidate counts by the same non-goalkeeper zones
feature_vector.matchup_pair_features: for each preregistered interaction pair, product of the two source-backed zone player counts; no manually signed advantage score

hyperparameter_policy.feature_standardization: fit mean/std on each fold training history only; zero-variance features fixed to standardized value 0
hyperparameter_policy.objective: binary Draw cross-entropy induced by the offset model plus L2 penalty on beta excluding the intercept

train_policy_test_split.design: expanding chronological OOS with three sequential test folds
train_policy_test_split.same_day_rule: all fixtures sharing the same UTC kickoff calendar date remain in one block; boundaries extend forward to the end of the boundary date and no outcome from that date may update another prediction on the same date
train_policy_test_split.fold_1: fit on initial chronological training block; score next test block
train_policy_test_split.fold_2: refit on all strictly earlier completed blocks only; score next test block
train_policy_test_split.fold_3: refit on all strictly earlier completed blocks only; score final test block

primary_metric.name: MULTICLASS_HDA_LOGLOSS
primary_metric.pooled_success_rule: paired 90% calendar-date-block bootstrap interval upper bound must be < 0
primary_metric.fold_stability_rule: at least 2 of 3 chronological test folds must have mean delta < 0

secondary_metrics.draw_required_rule: pooled Draw binary LogLoss delta must be < 0 and at least 2 of 3 folds must be <= 0
calibration_required: reliability table by preregistered deciles where sample size permits

bootstrap_unit.reason: preserve within-day dependence and enforce the same-day no-leakage policy

coverage_gate.if_gate_fails: STOP_DATA_COVERAGE; DO_NOT LOWER SAMPLE GATE; DO NOT FIT; DO NOT READ TARGET LABELS

stopping_rule.pre_label: continue prospective zero-label capture until the frozen coverage gate and sample identity manifest are complete; otherwise STOP_DATA_COVERAGE
stopping_rule.post_authorization: execute all three folds; no score-based early stopping and no candidate replacement
stopping_rule.scientific_pass: all primary rules plus draw-required secondary rule plus Brier/RPS non-material-worse rules must pass
stopping_rule.scientific_fail: any required scientific rule fails after authorized complete execution
stopping_rule.after_fail: seal the exact candidate on consumed labels; do not retune and reuse the same test identities

sample_identity_policy.selection: prospective chronological fixtures only; fixture must be registered before kickoff and must satisfy all R45B evidence contracts plus same-freeze baseline requirement
sample_identity_policy.ordering: kickoff_at_utc ascending, then competition_id, then immutable fixture_key

requirements_before_authorization_file_m: this preregistration is immutable and validation-passed
forward sample identity manifest satisfies coverage gate and has SHA-256
explicit independent OOS authorization is provided after the first three requirements
